source_record.scope: GSC-GRID-G4P3 pattern/F4P3 exact grid manufacturing range
source_record.reason: Current Uchirimo business WEB catalog/P99/P115 and product catalog were rechecked. P115 explicitly distinguishes transparent/frosted grid ranges but does not publish an independent pattern/F4P3 range.

source_record.scope: GSC-IGU-G4P3 tempered IGU reverse-orientation-safe manufacturing range
source_record.reason: Current common glass P65 lists T4P3/K4P3 but no P3T4/P3K4 or explicit Uchirimo reverse-orientation equivalence. A legacy Plamado-U notation was found but rejected as non-applicable cross-series evidence.

source_record.scope: GSC-SG-W3 plain/no-muntin exact glass manufacturing range
source_record.reason: Current Uchirimo P99 independent single-pane table omits W3. Current FAQ/product catalog confirm category/orderability but provide no independent W3 manufacturing dimensions.

source_record.scope: GSC-SG-W5 plain/no-muntin exact glass manufacturing range
source_record.reason: Current Uchirimo P99 independent single-pane table omits W5. Current FAQ/product catalog confirm category/orderability but provide no independent W5 manufacturing dimensions.
